source.source_yaml:
name: Clued standard runner actor qualification

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      admission_run_id:
        description: Exact existing dispatch admission for this Source/ref/claim
        required: true
        type: string
      node_id:
        description: Closed requested row selector; never execution authority
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - desk-w-591-windows-runner-caches
          - turing-windows-runner-caches

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: clued-standard-runner-actor-once
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  qualify-company:
    name: standard-runner-actor-company
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor_id == '52366662' && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner && inputs.node_id == 'desk-w-591-windows-runner-caches'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-node24, cap-python312, site-company]
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Run the exact admitted standard-runner actor adapter
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          & node scripts/runner/qualify-standard-runner-actor.mjs --execute
          exit $LASTEXITCODE

  qualify-home:
    name: standard-runner-actor-home
    needs: admission-gate
    if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor_id == '52366662' && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner && inputs.node_id == 'turing-windows-runner-caches'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-node24, cap-python312, site-home]
    timeout-minutes: 8
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - name: Run the exact admitted standard-runner actor adapter
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          & node scripts/runner/qualify-standard-runner-actor.mjs --execute
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
